_comment: Which substance a contested alias resolves to, when the ranked rule in resolve_alias_owners() (popularAliases claim, data over a stub, popularity, name) picks the wrong one. Keys are normalized aliases (pipeline normalise(): lowercased, salt suffix stripped). The owner must be one of the key's claimants or the build fails; every other claimant keeps the alias for display and search. Each entry says what the name refers to.

cesamet.why: Cesamet is the US brand of nabilone capsules (FDA NDA 018677).

kat.why: Kat is a spelling of khat (Catha edulis), the plant; methcathinone's street names are cat and jeff.

monase.why: Monase was Upjohn's brand of etryptamine (alpha-ethyltryptamine) acetate, marketed as an antidepressant in 1961.

pepto bismol.why: Pepto-Bismol's active ingredient is bismuth subsalicylate.

wax.why: Wax is a butane-extracted cannabis concentrate.

whiz.why: Whizz is British slang for amphetamine sulfate (speed).
